thread:
maria: Heads-up: customer reported missing rewrap audit entries after BYOK rotation in eu-west-1. Need quick triage.

nate: Which customer? any logs?

maria: ACME corp. They rotated their CMK yesterday. We see new key version, but our central audit index has no 'rewrap' events. Only 'import' and 'grant' entries.

kevin: Is that for our HSM proxy or direct KMS? Could be proxy's proxy-mode skipping event emission.

linh: Looking at proxy logs now. I see the rewrap request hit proxy, but proxy returned 202 and we forwarded to HSM. No audit write in kafka. Possibly RBAC failure when writing to audits topic.

sre-bot: Alert suppressed: kafka:audits - write error 403 - topic acl denied

nate: 403 from kafka? That suggests a service principal lost write permission. Did we change the auditing-role RBAC last week? @maria

maria: Yes—we merged a PR to tighten producer IAM. It should still allow audits-producer, but maybe the principal used by hsm-proxy changed after deploy.

kevin: Workaround: rerun write as admin to backfill customer events. But first we need to confirm key custody chain: did HSM rewrap occur in customer HSM or our ephemeral escrow? ACME requested BYOK local HSM, so it's customer-side. That may affect audit path.

linh: Quick check: here's the proxy trace (pseudolog):
```
2026-03-20T22:13:02Z hsm-proxy reqID=abcd rewrap start keyId=acme:cmk-7
2026-03-20T22:13:03Z hsm-proxy reqID=abcd forward->hsm status=200
2026-03-20T22:13:04Z hsm-proxy reqID=abcd audit=write kafka://audits topic=rewrap-events err=403
```

nate: OK that's the evidence. Raise an incident? It's P2 (customer data missing in audit).

maria: :eyes: I'd prefer a short-lived incident channel. Steps: 1) restore producer acl 2) backfill events 3) postmortem + RBAC rollback if needed.

kevin: Also need compliance note: for BYOK customer-managed keys, audit chain must contain both rewrap and key-version events with HSM attestation. I'll draft a checklist for legal/compliance.

linh: For immediate triage I'm going to re-add the producer role to the hsm-proxy principal and trigger a backfill job. Will post status.

sre-bot: Deployment note: previous RBAC PR removed `audits:producer` from `hsm-proxy-svc` due to mis-tagging. Reverting in progress.

nate: Ping me when backfill completes. Also add a monitoring rule: if rewrap-events missing for >1 hour for any customer with BYOK, page eng-security.

maria: Agree. Also action item: verify our KMS integration docs make it clear which side emits events (customer HSM vs our escrow) and which principals need producer rights.

kevin: I'll set up the compliance checklist and reach out to ACME for attestation logs.

linh: Backfill started @2026-03-20T22:20Z. will update when done.

maria: Thanks. Closing here once backfill + alerting are in place. :thumbsup:
